message.content: Painting the entire exterior of the Eiffel Tower would be a massive undertaking. In practice, the tower’s maintenance schedule includes repainting every 7–10 years as part of routine upkeep. If you were to start from scratch—cleaning, priming, applying primer coats, then two layers of protective paint—the work would likely take **several months** (roughly 4–6 months) if a dedicated crew worked full‑time under good weather conditions. If you had a very small team or limited resources, it could stretch into a year or more. The exact duration depends on crew size, equipment, weather, and whether you’re doing a full overhaul or just touch‑ups.
